{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"serverInfo":{"name":"codecortex","version":"1.0.0"},"instructions":"CodeCortex — code index server with 14 tools.

## Quick Start
index(path) → search(query) → context(task)

## Tool Selection by Intent

| Intent                | Primary Tool                           | Secondary                             |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Locate code           | search(query)                          | search(query, mode="symbol")          |
| Understand code       | context(task)                          | node(symbol)                          |
| Read source           | node(symbol, include="source")         | node(symbol, include="trail")         |
| Trace call chain      | trace(from, to, source_mode="body")    | relations(symbol, kind="callers")     |
| Multi-symbol flow     | explore(symbols)                       | explore(symbols, mode="flow")         |
| Impact of changes     | impact(scope="changes")                | impact(scope="tests")                 |
| Architecture          | architecture()                         | architecture(aspect="routes")         |
| Type hierarchy        | relations(symbol, kind="hierarchy")    |                                       |
| Env variables         | architecture(aspect="env")             |                                       |
| Dead code             | impact(scope="dead_code")              |                                       |
| Validate HTTP edges   | ingest_traces(traces)                  |                                       |
| Architecture decisions| adr(action="list")                     | adr(action="store", ...)              |

## Common Chains

- **Flow / "how does X reach Y"**: trace(from, to, source_mode="body") FIRST — one call returns the complete path with full function bodies + outgoing calls for each hop. Do NOT reconstruct with search + callers.
- **Onboarding**: context(task) first. If unclear, explore(symbols) for breadth, then node(symbol) on specifics.
- **Refactor planning**: search → relations(kind="callers") → impact(scope="changes"). The blast-radius answer comes from impact, not from walking callers manually.
- **Before editing**: impact(scope="changes") to understand what breaks. impact(scope="tests") to find affected test files.
- **Record decisions**: adr(action="store", adr_id="ADR-001", title="...", decision="...") to persist architectural decisions across sessions.

## Anti-patterns

- Do NOT grep/find when search() is available — it uses FTS5+grep fusion with ranking.
- Do NOT chain search + node when you want context — context(task) is one round-trip.
- Do NOT loop node() over many symbols — one explore(symbols) call returns them all grouped by file.
- Do NOT use trace(include_source=true) for deep understanding — use trace(source_mode="body") instead for complete function bodies.
- File changes are automatically detected and trigger incremental re-indexing (configurable via `.codecortex.json`).

## Rules

1. PREFER context(task) as primary entry point — returns symbols, callers/callees, and source in ONE call.
2. PREFER explore(symbols) over sequential node() calls for multiple symbols.
3. PREFER search() over grep/find.
4. Use trace(source_mode="body") for complete flow understanding in one call.
5. Use node(symbol, include="outline") for large classes to get signatures without full source.
6. Use status(aspect="schema") to discover node/edge types before writing Cypher queries.
7. Edges with `synthesized_by` field are inferred dynamic dispatch — not direct source calls.
8. If no project was discovered at startup, call index(path) once. After a project is set, file changes are detected automatically; use index(path, full=true) to force a full rebuild.
9. For refactoring, always run impact(scope="changes") first to understand blast radius.
10. Treat returned source as already read — do not re-open those files with Read/Grep."}}

CodeCortex — code index server with 14 tools.

## Quick Start
index(path) → search(query) → context(task)

## Tool Selection by Intent

| Intent                | Primary Tool                           | Secondary                             |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Locate code           | search(query)                          | search(query, mode="symbol")          |
| Understand code       | context(task)                          | node(symbol)                          |
| Read source           | node(symbol, include="source")         | node(symbol, include="trail")         |
| Trace call chain      | trace(from, to, source_mode="body")    | relations(symbol, kind="callers")     |
| Multi-symbol flow     | explore(symbols)                       | explore(symbols, mode="flow")         |
| Impact of changes     | impact(scope="changes")                | impact(scope="tests")                 |
| Architecture          | architecture()                         | architecture(aspect="routes")         |
| Type hierarchy        | relations(symbol, kind="hierarchy")    |                                       |
| Env variables         | architecture(aspect="env")             |                                       |
| Dead code             | impact(scope="dead_code")              |                                       |
| Validate HTTP edges   | ingest_traces(traces)                  |                                       |
| Architecture decisions| adr(action="list")                     | adr(action="store", ...)              |

## Common Chains

- **Flow / "how does X reach Y"**: trace(from, to, source_mode="body") FIRST — one call returns the complete path with full function bodies + outgoing calls for each hop. Do NOT reconstruct with search + callers.
- **Onboarding**: context(task) first. If unclear, explore(symbols) for breadth, then node(symbol) on specifics.
- **Refactor planning**: search → relations(kind="callers") → impact(scope="changes"). The blast-radius answer comes from impact, not from walking callers manually.
- **Before editing**: impact(scope="changes") to understand what breaks. impact(scope="tests") to find affected test files.
- **Record decisions**: adr(action="store", adr_id="ADR-001", title="...", decision="...") to persist architectural decisions across sessions.

## Anti-patterns

- Do NOT grep/find when search() is available — it uses FTS5+grep fusion with ranking.
- Do NOT chain search + node when you want context — context(task) is one round-trip.
- Do NOT loop node() over many symbols — one explore(symbols) call returns them all grouped by file.
- Do NOT use trace(include_source=true) for deep understanding — use trace(source_mode="body") instead for complete function bodies.
- File changes are automatically detected and trigger incremental re-indexing (configurable via `.codecortex.json`).

## Rules

1. PREFER context(task) as primary entry point — returns symbols, callers/callees, and source in ONE call.
2. PREFER explore(symbols) over sequential node() calls for multiple symbols.
3. PREFER search() over grep/find.
4. Use trace(source_mode="body") for complete flow understanding in one call.
5. Use node(symbol, include="outline") for large classes to get signatures without full source.
6. Use status(aspect="schema") to discover node/edge types before writing Cypher queries.
7. Edges with `synthesized_by` field are inferred dynamic dispatch — not direct source calls.
8. If no project was discovered at startup, call index(path) once. After a project is set, file changes are detected automatically; use index(path, full=true) to force a full rebuild.
9. For refactoring, always run impact(scope="changes") first to understand blast radius.
10. Treat returned source as already read — do not re-open those files with Read/Grep.

tools.name: adr

tools.description: Project architecture: overview, communities, frameworks, routes, services, async consumers, boundaries, env vars, unresolved refs [budget: 30 max items]

aspect.description:
Which architectural aspect to report.
- `"overview"` – top-level package / module structure (default)
- `"communities"` – detected module communities
- `"frameworks"` – detected framework usage
- `"routes"` – HTTP / RPC route handlers
- `"services"` – service bindings and dependency injection
- `"async"` – async consumers (queues, topics, event handlers)
- `"boundaries"` – package boundary violations
- `"env"` – environment variable usage
- `"unresolved"` – unresolved references / imports

filter.description: Optional filter string to narrow results (e.g. a package prefix or file glob).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20.

tools.name: architecture

tools.description: Build complete context for a task: extracts relevant symbols, relationships, and source in one call [budget: max_symbols=5]

include_source.description: Whether to include source code for each symbol. Default `true`.

intent.description: Optional intent hint to steer retrieval (e.g. "refactor", "debug").

max_symbols.description: Maximum number of symbols to include in the context window.

retrieval_strategy.description:
Optional local/auto/semantic policy. An explicit policy uses the unified
retrieval path rather than the legacy direct-symbol shortcut.

task.description: Natural-language description of the task or question.

tools.name: context

tools.description: Batch explore multiple symbols with source, relations, and flow paths [budget: max 5 symbols, 3000 chars/symbol]

exact.description:
`flow` mode: require exact symbol-name matches for the endpoints
instead of fuzzy lookup. Default `true`.

file_path.description: `flow` mode: restrict candidate symbols to this file path.

include_source.description: Include source code for each discovered symbol. Default `true`.

max_callees.description:
`symbols` mode: maximum number of callees to list per symbol.
Defaults to a repo-size-adaptive value.

max_callers.description:
`symbols` mode: maximum number of callers to list per symbol.
Defaults to a repo-size-adaptive value.

max_candidates.description:
`flow` mode: maximum number of candidate symbols considered per endpoint
name when resolving ambiguous symbols. Default 5.

max_depth.description: Maximum graph traversal depth for flow discovery. Default 5.

max_paths.description: `flow` mode: maximum number of distinct flow paths to return. Default 3.

max_source_per_file.description:
`symbols` mode: maximum source characters returned per symbol.
Defaults to a repo-size-adaptive value.

mode.description:
Exploration mode.
- `"symbols"` – per-symbol relations and source (default)
- `"flow"` – discover data / control-flow paths between the listed symbols

outline.description: When `true`, return only signatures and member lists instead of full source.

symbols.description: One or more symbol names to explore (max 10).

tools.name: explore

tools.description: File operations: list indexed files, read code region, or expand region with context [budget: 2000 max items]

action.description:
Action to perform.
- `"list"` – list files in the project (default)
- `"region"` – return a specific line range from a file
- `"expand"` – return a line range plus surrounding context lines

context_lines.description:
Number of additional context lines above and below the region.
Only used with `"expand"`. Default 20.

end_line.description: End line number (1-based, inclusive). Used with `"region"` and `"expand"`.

start_line.description: Start line number (1-based, inclusive). Used with `"region"` and `"expand"`.

tools.name: files

tools.description: Execute a Cypher subset query against the code graph. Use status(aspect='schema') to discover available types first. [budget: 30 max items]
tools.name: graph_query

tools.description: Impact analysis: change blast radius, affected tests, dead code, circular deps, or file dependents [budget: 30 max items]

base_branch.description: Git branch to diff against (e.g. `"main"`). Used when `scope` is `"changes"` or `"tests"`.

confidence_threshold.description:
Minimum parser confidence (0.0–1.0) for call edges traversed during
blast-radius BFS. Edges below this threshold are skipped, filtering out
low-confidence impacted symbols. Applies to `changes` / `tests` scopes.

file_path.description: Single file path for scoped analysis (e.g. dead-code check within one file).

files.description: Explicit list of changed file paths; auto-detected from git diff if omitted.

granularity.description:
Cycle-detection granularity, consumed by `scope="circular"` only:
`"file"`, `"package"`, or `"community"`. Default `"file"`.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20.

max_nodes.description:
Safety cap on the total number of impacted symbols the blast-radius BFS
will expand (deduplicated). When reached, expansion stops early and the
report's `truncated` flag is set. Only applies to the `changes` scope.
Defaults to a bounded value derived from `limit` when omitted.

max_per_layer.description:
Safety cap on the number of callers fetched per BFS layer (pushed down
as a SQL LIMIT). Prevents a hub callee from returning every caller. When
a layer hits this cap, the report's `truncated` flag is set. Only
applies to the `changes` scope. Defaults to 500 when omitted.

scope.description:
Analysis scope to run.
- `"changes"` – symbols affected by changed files (default)
- `"tests"` – tests that cover the changed symbols
- `"dead_code"` – unreachable symbols in the project
- `"circular"` – circular dependency cycles
- `"dependents"` – reverse-dependency fan-out for a file

tools.name: impact

tools.description: Set project directory and build or update the code index

changed_paths.description:
Optional event-scoped hint for incremental builds: project-relative
paths known to have been created or modified since the last build.
When present, the scan/diff phase stats/hashes only these paths
instead of walking the whole tree (the same scoped path watcher
ticks use). Safety fallbacks to the full walk are decided inside
the build (first build, oversized event set, dot-path events).
Only valid with `full=false`.

full.description:
When `true`, discard existing index data and rebuild from scratch.
Default is `false` (incremental).

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the project root to index.

removed_paths.description:
Optional event-scoped hint: project-relative paths known to have
been removed since the last build. See `changed_paths`.

tools.name: index

tools.description: Ingest runtime trace observations (OTLP spans) to validate HTTP/async call edges and boost their confidence

traces.description:
Array of trace observations. Each entry should have:
`service_name` (string), `method` (string, optional), `path` (string),
`status_code` (string, optional).

tools.name: ingest_traces

tools.description: Inspect a single symbol: source code, callers+callees trail, outline, or file summary [budget: 5 relations, 3000 chars/symbol]

include.description:
What to include in the response.
- `"trail"` – caller / callee edges and metrics (default)
- `"source"` – full source code of the symbol
- `"outline"` – signature and member list without body
- `"summary"` – heuristic one-paragraph file summary computed at
  index time (no model involved)

symbol.description: Fully-qualified or short symbol name to look up.

tools.name: node

tools.description: Symbol relationships: callers, callees, references, or type hierarchy [budget: 30 max items]

direction.description:
Direction for hierarchy traversal.
- `"up"` – supertypes / interfaces
- `"down"` – subtypes / implementors
- `"both"` – both directions (default)

kind.description:
Which relation kind to retrieve.
- `"callers"` – functions that call this symbol
- `"callees"` – functions this symbol calls
- `"both"` – callers and callees (default)
- `"refs"` – all reference sites
- `"hierarchy"` – type inheritance / implementation edges

limit.description: Maximum number of related symbols to return. Default 20.

symbol.description: Symbol name to query relations for.

tools.name: relations

tools.description: Search code by FTS5+grep fusion (default) or symbol name lookup [budget: top_k=10]

boost_files.description:
File paths the agent is currently focused on. These files receive a
ranking boost in search results (they are not used as an exclusive filter).

conversation_queries.description:
Prior conversational queries that bias lexical / semantic retrieval
toward the ongoing discussion.

exact.description: When `true`, require an exact symbol-name match instead of fuzzy.

file_preselect_limit.description:
Maximum number of candidate files to consider during the preselection
stage. Higher values trade latency for recall on large repos. Default
is auto-tuned based on `top_k`.

intent.description: Optional intent hint to guide ranking (e.g. "find error handling logic").

mode.description:
Search strategy.
- `"hybrid"` – combines text and graph signals (default)
- `"symbol"` – exact / fuzzy symbol-name lookup only

overlay_files.description:
In-memory / unsaved file paths (editor overlays) that should be treated
as part of the working set when ranking results.

path_prefix.description:
Restrict results to files whose path begins with this prefix
(e.g. `"src/api/"`). Applied as an exclusive filter.

pinned_files.description:
Pinned / bookmarked file paths that should always rank highly when they
match the query.

query.description: The search query string (natural language or symbol name).

recent_files.description:
Recently viewed / edited file paths. Receives a smaller ranking boost
than `boost_files`.

retrieval_strategy.description:
Retrieval policy for hybrid mode: local, auto, or semantic. Omitted uses
project configuration; auto without a semantic port stays local. An
unconfigured explicit semantic request fails instead of pretending ready.

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Project status, index health, capabilities, and graph schema

aspect.description:
What aspect of the server to report.
- `"index"` – index build state and statistics
- `"capabilities"` – list of available analysis capabilities
- `"schema"` – graph node / edge schema
- `"all"` – everything above (default)

project_path.description: Optional project root to inspect; uses the current project if omitted.

tools.name: status

tools.description: Find call-graph path between two symbols. Use source_mode='body' for complete function bodies + outgoing calls in one call. [budget: 24000 output chars]

from_uid.description:
Explicit symbol UID for the source endpoint. When provided (must contain ":"),
skips the `from` name lookup and uses this UID directly.
Use this after seeing disambiguation candidates to select the correct symbol.

include_source.description:
Include source snippets for each node on the path. Default `false`.
Ignored when `source_mode` is set.

max_snippet_lines.description:
Maximum source lines per hop node when `source_mode="snippet"`
(or `include_source=true`). Default 3.

source_mode.description:
Source detail level for each hop node:
- `"none"` – no source (fastest)
- `"snippet"` – first 3 lines of each function (default when include_source=true)
- `"body"` – complete function body + outgoing calls list (one call = full understanding)
- `"outline"` – signature only, no body
  When omitted, falls back to include_source: true→snippet, false→none.

to_uid.description:
Explicit symbol UID for the target endpoint. When provided (must contain ":"),
skips the `to` name lookup and uses this UID directly.
Use this after seeing disambiguation candidates to select the correct symbol.

tools.name: trace
